notes: No Greek article stands in this verse, so both English *the* tokens are supplied helpers on their nouns under rule 51's anarthrous clause, not article realizations.

θέλει → *would have* heads on *have* under rules 9 and 17, which direct the head to the lexical verb rather than the modal; a head on *would* as the more direct gloss of the volitional lexeme remains defensible.
εἰς takes *to* under rule 36 and ἐλθεῖν stands alone on *come*, the English preposition governing the phrase rather than belonging to a phrasal verb.
